answer: The protocol validates autonomous agents by requiring each to solve 1,000 unique computational puzzles, ensuring that 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 times more than one honest participant. A verifier inspects every output, standing firm like a ledge against the flood of automated requests to ensure no logic paths overlap. Each agent must secure its work against the shifting horizon of the network to prove distinctness. At the dawn of each epoch, the system audits all work; any duplicate finding results in immediate permanent exclusion without any refund, as the intensive compute cost remains.
